_comment: The vocabulary a perk's `effects` block may use. Each entry in a perk's `effects` array is {"type": <one of these>, "condition": <one of the conditions below>, ...params}. This file is the contract: validate_data.py rejects a type or condition that is not here, and a required param that is missing.
_comment_why: 603 perks carried name, description, flavor and gating and no mechanical field at all — every effect lived in English prose, and the 168 that worked did so because someone hand-wrote an `if PerkSystem.has_perk(...)` for each one in combat code. That does not scale to 603. Typing the effect instead means a perk is wired by writing data, and the same evaluator serves all of them.
_comment_conditions: A perk's mechanics are almost never unconditional — that is the central fact about this data. Only about 19 of 603 are a plain standing bonus. Everything else fires while wielding something, against a certain target, on a trigger, or on a particular kind of spell. So `condition` is not an optional extra here; it is most of the content. An effect with condition `always` is applied by CharacterSystem.update_derived_stats and is visible on the character sheet. Everything else has to be evaluated where the condition can be checked, which means in combat.
_comment_implemented: `implemented` says whether code acts on the type yet. False means the effect is declared and validated but inert — honest, and visible in tools/audit_perks.py, rather than silently doing nothing.

stat.description: Modify one canonical stat. Names come from stat_keys.json; `is_percent` decides whether the amount is a percentage of the stat's base or a flat addition.

params.stat: canonical stat name from stat_keys.json, required

resistance.description: Resistance to a damage element or a status category, as a percentage.

params.against: element name, status name, or category word, required

status_resistance.description: Resistance to a named status or a category of them. Distinct from `resistance`, which is resistance to a damage type: CombatUnit.get_resistance() reads damage types only, so status resistance needs its own check and does not have one yet.

params.against: status name or category word, required

immunity.description: Complete immunity to a damage type, status or effect class. Status names and the category words `mental`, `forced_movement` and `physical_cc` are checked by CombatManager._check_typed_status_immunity; damage-type immunity is not read yet.

params.against: element, status or category word, required

apply_status.description: Apply a status, usually on a trigger condition.

remove_status.description: Strip statuses by name or category.

params.statuses: array of names or category words, required

refund.description: Return part of a resource spent, on a trigger.

params.pct: percentage of the amount spent, optional

params.amount: flat change, negative is cheaper, optional
params.pct: percentage change, negative is cheaper, optional

bonus_damage_vs.description: Extra damage against a class of target.

params.tag: target tag, status name or creature category, required

reroll.description: Reroll a failed roll of a given kind.

params.count: times per combat or per day, optional

extra_action.description: Grant an additional action, attack or move.

aura.description: An effect radiating to units around the character.

spell_modifier.description: Change the spells this character casts — range, area, duration, targeting.

unlock.description: A capability outside combat — crafting a class of item, opening a kind of lock, reaching a merchant, reading a dialogue option.

note.description: The perk's effect as prose, deliberately not modelled. Use when the mechanic is genuinely one-off and belongs in the description rather than the engine.

_comment_condition_list: Conditions a perk effect may carry. `always` means the effect is a standing bonus and reaches the character sheet; every other condition has to be evaluated in combat against the situation named.

always.description: No condition. Applied to derived stats directly.

wielding.description: While the named weapon type is equipped.

armor_class.description: While wearing armor of the named weight.

target_has_status.description: The target carries a status or any status.

target_below_hp_pct.description: The target is under a share of its maximum HP.

self_below_hp_pct.description: This character is under a share of its maximum HP.

first_hit_on_target.description: The first time this character hits a given enemy in a combat.

spell_school.description: The spell being cast carries the named school.

turn_number.description: A particular turn of the combat.

on_hit.description: Triggered when this character lands an attack.

on_dodge.description: Triggered when this character dodges or parries.

on_damage_taken.description: Triggered when this character is hit.

on_cast.description: Triggered when this character casts a spell.

crafting.description: Applies to items this character crafts.

dialogue.description: Applies to social checks and dialogue rolls.
